scope: Prospective pure transfer control with native56-node geometry/T/ne/rho and complete native41-level O n/nstar/totals. Native HOP LTE EOS/continuum and explicit native H/He perturber densities; unchanged LW atomic and broadening formulas, five native Lobatto angles and native-constant background source. No SE/collision/population update. Both nativeNLTE and nativeLTE cases, common native dense vacuum grid, no fitted shift/continuum. Top zero incoming; LW thermalized lower-boundary and native ghost/formal/profile/constants differences remain explicit. Report all six finite-window contrasts with no result-selected input or adopted model. Prospective LW linear formal solver at the same original native state; compared with native linear-output-only control. No agreement-selected production default. Explicit native Stark-off run populations consumed in full, including measured0.2103percent maximum population response. This isolates paired transfer at the new state; no original-state population equality claim. Prospective explicit He contribution disabled solely at LW elastic-broadening interface, to compare native HI-only damping. Native EOS/He density/continuum/atomic O populations and all remaining formulas retained. No helium abundance or production recipe change.
